HBASE-27.reason: Healthy JUnit reaches HRegionServer.blockAndCheckIfStopped without throwing. Trials 3, 4, and 9 inject IOException into HMaster.tryMigrateMetaLocationsFromZooKeeper at ResultScanner.next or close. HMaster aborts, the cluster shuts down its sole RegionServer, and HRegionServer.stop sets stopped=true. The selected check then intentionally throws 'Received the shutdown message while waiting.' This is the source-defined shutdown path following the injected master startup failure, not an independent coordination defect.
